source: User-supplied Wave Race 64 USA revision 1 ROM on VENGEANCE
method: Original music sequences and ADPCM instrument samples extracted locally; normal-race and final-lap variation control flow resolved before sequence conversion; rendered offline on EVO X2 and encoded into standalone MP3 files.
tools: FFmpeg / libmp3lame installed on EVO X2
mix: Original compositions and instrument samples. Offline MIDI/SoundFont rendering approximates envelopes and reverb; not a bit-exact N64 RSP recording. Source waits determine loops, with a second traversal retaining release and reverb tails. Eight final-lap tracks include original sequence1A fanfare, a .9s theme delay derived from18 source50ms outer frames, and a2s presentation fade approximating the audio engine120-unit fade. Final-lap tempo and entry section come from each original variation1 branch. Fanfare plays only before the first traversal.
